hero.title: Zero-Telemetry Developer Tools Built for Raw Velocity

privacy.title: 100% Client-Side Privacy
privacy.text: Every regex, JSON payload, token, and hash is computed inside your local browser via WebAssembly and WebWorkers. Zero network payloads.

payloads.question: Are my payloads, tokens, or sensitive JSON strings saved to any server?
payloads.answer: Never. All compute happens synchronously inside your browser context. No analytics, no telemetry, no backend databases. Even if you disconnect your WiFi, every single utility functions identically.

offline.question: Can I use Dev Tools Showcase offline or in air-gapped environments?
offline.answer: Yes. Once a page has loaded, every utility runs locally and needs no network connection, so it keeps working in air-gapped environments.

contribute.question: How can I submit or contribute a new micro-tool?
contribute.answer: Fork the repository on GitHub, add your tool as a small self-contained module and open a pull request. The contribution guide in the README describes the steps.

free.question: Is it completely free and open source?
free.answer: Yes. The source code is MIT-licensed and every utility is free to use, with no accounts, usage limits or ads.
